extracted.intended_audience: PR / communications professionals, agencies, investor relations teams, businesses seeking press release distribution
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for distributing press releases and multimedia to media and consumers worldwide, including targeting, editorial preparation, multimedia use, compliance for investor relations, and measurement of impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic reach and language coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: GlobeNewswire press releases reach 158 countries in 35 local languages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose distribution that matches the geographic scope of your news; aim to reach audiences in the countries and local languages relevant to your announcement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Targeting by newslines (geography, industry, media type)
rubrics_metrics.description: You can choose from more than 1,000 newslines to target your news by geography, industry, and media type.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use newslines to narrowly target journalists and outlets most likely to care about your story (e.g., industry-specific or region-specific feeds) rather than blasting everywhere.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investor relations & regulatory distribution options
rubrics_metrics.description: For investor relations professionals, we provide distribution options for material and financial news distribution, along with regulatory filing solutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When issuing financial or material news, select distribution channels and filing services designed for regulatory compliance and investor audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of multimedia (Media Snippets) to boost visibility and engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Media Snippets let you embed interactive carousels with infographics, PDFs, audio and video elements — including live streaming events — directly into your press release.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include rich media (infographics, video, audio, PDFs, live streams) to drive engagement and visual interest; distributing multimedia to partners (AP Photo Express, CP Photo Network, Newscom Archive, Yahoo! Photo and YouTube) increases pickup and reuse.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial quality and full-service editorial support
rubrics_metrics.description: Our editorial team can work with you to help prepare and distribute your news and answer questions you have along the way. We provide 24/7/365 editorial support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prevent typos, broken links, and missed deadlines by using professional editorial review; treat editorial quality as mandatory (anti-pattern: publishing releases with typos/broken links).

rubrics_metrics.name: Translation services for local-language distribution
rubrics_metrics.description: We can also provide translation services when required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use professional translation when distributing to non-native-language markets to maximize comprehension and media pickup.

rubrics_metrics.name: Analytics and measurable performance metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Newswire Analytics post-distribution performance reporting provides the number of people who viewed it, social media shares, multimedia engagement, link click throughs, and more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monitor views, shares, multimedia engagement, and click-throughs using live dashboards and widgets; require immediate availability of reports after publication to tie activity back to business goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Real-time, shareable reporting and dashboards
rubrics_metrics.description: Newswire Analytics delivers meaningful metrics in a user-friendly format, using widgets and live dashboards instead of static reports. Your report is available immediately after your release is published and is easy to share.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer platforms offering instant, shareable dashboards over delayed static PDFs so stakeholders can act on results quickly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integrated PR workflow / platform capabilities
rubrics_metrics.description: Full-service GlobeNewswire press release distribution is available within our Notified PR platform: social listening, media monitoring, a media contacts database, press release distribution, online newsrooms, and measurement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use an integrated platform to centralize distribution, monitoring, contact management, newsroom hosting, and measurement for a cohesive workflow and single sign-on convenience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Earned media reporting and ROI linkage
rubrics_metrics.description: An exclusive benefit ... is enhanced reporting and analytics — including complementary earned media reports. We tap into our global monitoring capabilities to provide you with online media coverage resulting from your press releases so that you can tie ROI directly to your press releases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Track earned coverage generated by releases and use monitoring-derived earned media reports to calculate and demonstrate PR ROI.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enriched emails to reach key influencers
rubrics_metrics.description: Reach key influencers with Enriched Emails — feature-rich, engaging emails which take advantage of flexible templates and simple layout tools.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complement public distribution with targeted, template-driven emails to influencers and journalists to increase pickup; use simple layout tools to keep emails focused and engaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flexible distribution options to fit needs and budget
rubrics_metrics.description: We have options to fit your specific needs and budget, and editorial services that are second to none.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select a distribution package aligned with your objectives and resources; balance breadth of reach, targeting precision, and added services (editorial, translation, multimedia) against budget.
